raw.description:
About Us:

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

Product Offering:

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:

Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

What It's Like to Work Here:

We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.
About the Role:

We're hiring a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own operations across the full customer lifecycle: the funnel, systems, numbers, deals, and post-sale motion. You'll report directly to the Senior Director of Revenue Operations as the senior individual contributor on a small team, setting the standard for how the work gets done.

Be clear-eyed about one thing: this is a hands-on role. There's a real backlog, and for the first stretch you'll be in the work — building the reports, running the deal desk, fixing the data — while automating it as you go. The leverage compounds, but it doesn't start on day one.

The substance of the job is core revenue operations: sales operations, GTM strategy and planning, deal desk, forecasting, incentive compensation, data management, and analytics. It also extends beyond the close: you'll be the operational partner to Account Management, Implementation, Customer Success, and Customer Support, which means renewals and amendments, onboarding milestones, health and adoption signals, and the handoffs between those teams all fall within your scope. Payments makes it more complex than most: our revenue moves with our customers' transaction volume, so getting the numbers right means understanding how the business actually works.

What's different is the leverage. We're building a RevOps function where AI carries more of the repeatable work, and this role sits at the center of that. You should already be using AI in your day-to-day work and be able to show us what you've built with it — not a certification, but real examples. You don't need to be an ML engineer, and we'll invest in deepening those skills. What we can't teach on the job is the operational foundation underneath it: knowing what a defensible forecast looks like, where a funnel definition breaks down, what a comp plan can't get wrong. That judgment is what makes automation trustworthy, and it's why this role needs both.

If you have the RevOps fundamentals and you're already building with AI, we'd like to talk.

This role is open to candidates based in Latin America (excluding Brazil)

Responsibilities:

  • Funnel architecture and governance: Own revenue operations across the full go-to-market funnel. Partner with sales, account management, customer success, and marketing to hold rigorous KPI governance and lifecycle definitions (MQL / SAL / SQL) that every team trusts and reports against.

  • Deal desk and commercial support: Run deal desk for non-standard structures — pricing exceptions, consumption commitments, multi-product bundles — and make sure what gets signed is what gets billed and reported.

  • Forecasting and planning: Own forecast accuracy, pipeline hygiene, and coverage analysis. Support territory, quota, and capacity planning alongside the Senior Director.

  • Incentive compensation: Administer and stress-test comp plans, model changes, and resolve disputes with a clear audit trail.

  • Customer operations: Extend the same operational rigor to the post-sale organization, supporting Account Management, Implementation, Customer Success, and Customer Support. Own the process, systems, and reporting behind renewals and amendments, onboarding and implementation milestones, health and adoption signals, escalation paths, and the handoffs between each team — so the customer journey holds together after the deal closes.

  • Data management and analytics: Own the integrity of GTM data — enrichment, deduplication, source attribution, and the metric definitions that keep two reports from answering the same question differently. Turn that into analysis leadership actually uses.

  • AI-enabled operations: Design and build the agents, automations, and workflows that carry the repeatable load: applying business rules, surfacing recommendations mid-cycle, flagging expansion signals and pipeline risk, and escalating to a human only where judgment is genuinely required. You'll be given latitude to decide what gets automated and what stays manual.

  • Systems partnership: Work in close partnership with our Salesforce owner and technical partners — you own the operational design and requirements; they own platform build and administration. Translate ambiguous business asks into solutions that hold up across the stack.

  • Raising the bar: Set the quality standard for how RevOps work gets done here. As the senior operator on the team, you'll help unblock the people around you, mentor where it's useful, and grow the range of the function overall.

  • Proactive ownership: Diagnose pipeline breakpoints and process friction and drive fixes cross-functionally. Nobody here will hand you a prescriptive task list.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or GTM operations — or equivalent depth in a closely related function — including at least 2 in a senior or lead capacity

  • Willingness to be hands-on. You'll be doing the work as well as designing it, particularly early on

  • Working command of the end-to-end customer journey, from top-of-funnel acquisition through post-sale retention and expansion, and the metrics that describe each stage

  • Hands-on depth in at least two of: deal desk, forecasting methodology, incentive compensation, or GTM data management and quality

  • Experience supporting post-sale teams — customer success, account management, implementation, or support operations — including renewal and expansion motion, health scoring, or onboarding process

  • Strong Salesforce fluency — reporting, objects and data model, and how operational processes get encoded in a CRM

  • Current, hands-on use of AI in your own work, with specific examples you can walk us through — an agent, an automation, an assistant, or a workflow you built and put to use. We care about what you've actually shipped, not which tool you used

  • A considered point of view on how AI changes operations work, and a track record of picking up new tooling quickly

  • Proven ability to manage senior stakeholders, translate between business and technical requirements, and influence teams you don't control

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, particularly with senior stakeholders

  • Strong prioritization and ownership in an environment with more opportunities than instruction

  • Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leveling up teammates, formally or informally

Additional Skills We Value:

  • Payments, fintech, or another usage-based or consumption-priced business

  • AI agents or LLM-backed workflows you've built for a commercial or operational team, running in production with other people depending on them

  • Hands-on work with automation platforms (n8n, Zapier) or agentic tooling (Claude and similar)

  • Enough technical comfort to work in a Git repo and ship something to a hosted environment — you don't need to be an engineer, but the people who thrive here can build, not only specify

  • SQL and hands-on work in a BI tool (we use Tableau)

  • CPQ, CLM, or billing-system experience (Salesforce CPQ, Ironclad)

  • Revenue intelligence tooling (Gong, Apollo)

  • Customer support and success platforms (Zendesk, Intercom) and the reporting that sits on top of them

We champion the ethical, creative use of AI—if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here.
--

We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training.

MediaAlpha is a customer acquisition solutions provider powered by technology and data science. The company provides industry-leading solutions designed to reach consumers shopping within high-consideration categories such as property and casualty insurance, health insurance, life insurance, and more.

Role Overview

MediaAlpha (NYSE: MAX) operates the world’s largest insurance advertising marketplace, connecting leading carriers and agents with high-intent insurance shoppers at scale. Our owned-and-operated media properties are a cornerstone of our business, and we’re building the paid media function that will drive transformational growth.

We’re looking for a Senior Director of Paid Media to lead that effort. Reporting into the VP of Growth Marketing, this is a high-impact, high-ownership role: you’ll set the strategy, own the budget, and build the team. You are first and foremost a paid social expert - specifically Meta - but you think like an investment manager across every channel you touch. You know how creative drives downstream lead quality, not just click-through rate, and you’re excited about using AI to produce and test creative at a scale most teams only dream about.

This role isn’t about managing agency relationships or reporting on what happened last week. It’s about building a best-in-class paid media capability from the ground up, inside the company that powers more insurance advertising than anyone else on the planet.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full paid media strategy across social, search, native, display, and retargeting, with Meta as your primary channel and proving ground
  • Set channel-level investment strategies, budget allocation frameworks, scaling criteria, and ROI guardrails across the portfolio
  • Define the strategic direction for paid media, aligning it with MediaAlpha’s broader growth strategy
  • Ensure positive ROI across all paid media investment; own performance accountability end-to-end
  • Hire, lead, coach, and develop a team of channel-specific analysts (paid social, paid search, native/display, etc.)
  • Translate campaign performance into clear, executive-ready narratives that connect channel metrics to business outcomes: cost per lead, revenue per lead, GP contribution, and margin
  • Partner directly with cross-functional leadership, extending your influence beyond the paid media team
  • Leverage AI tooling (both off-the-shelf and custom-built) to accelerate creative production and UGC video at scale
  • Build and run a high-velocity creative testing engine across static, video, and UGC formats, with a clear methodology for learning and scaling winners
  • Understand how ad creative affects downstream quality and conversion, and use that lens to guide every creative and targeting decision
  • Ensure all paid media activity complies with applicable laws, regulations, and platform policies — including TCPA and state-specific advertising requirements relevant to the insurance vertical

Requirements

  • You have personally managed $1M+ per month in Meta ad spend. This is a hard floor, not a preference; you’ve done this hands-on, not just at a strategic level
  • A proven track record running profitable, ROI-positive paid media in the lead generation space. eCommerce or brand-building backgrounds are not the right fit for this role
  • Experience working in a performance-first environment where every dollar of spend is expected to earn its place
  • A genuine command of what makes paid social work: creative diagnosis, audience strategy, bidding mechanics, and the ability to distinguish a creative problem from a targeting problem from a measurement problem
  • Experience running ads across search, display, native, and retargeting platforms - even if Meta is your primary channel
  • Experience building or scaling a paid media team, including hiring and developing junior channel specialists
  • Genuine enthusiasm for using AI tools to accelerate creative production at scale
  • A strong understanding of how ad creative, landing page experience, and lead intent interact to drive downstream quality, not just top-of-funnel volume
  • Experience in the insurance vertical or adjacent regulated categories (financial services, health, legal) is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with lead gen compliance requirements, including TCPA, state-level advertising rules, and platform-specific policy constraints is strongly preferred

Compensation & Benefits

We are excited to offer a competitive base pay range of $156,000 - $220,000 per year for this position, based on experience and qualifications. But that's not all - as a valued member of our team, you will also have access to an array of top-notch benefits, including:

  • Annual bonus program and participation in our Restricted Stock Unit program
  • 100% Employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance for you, your dependents, and spouse or registered domestic partner
  • 100% employer-paid long-term disability and life insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with matching contributions to help you plan for your future
  • Open Paid Time Off policy with a birthday day off, 13 holidays, and 5 Recharge days
  • Professional development reimbursement
  • Cell Phone, Wellness, and Internet expense reimbursement, along with a subscription to the Calm App
  • 100% fully paid parental leave for team members up to 22 weeks for the primary caregiver and 12 weeks for the secondary caregiver
  • Dog-friendly offices (LA and AZ) along with a $300 pet adoption reimbursement

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

MediaAlpha is committed to fostering, cultivating, and maintaining a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our philosophy and actions are built on the premise that as an employer and citizens of our communities, we can create opportunities for lasting change.

Fair Chance

MediaAlpha will consider qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with state and local "Fair Chance" laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans in our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at or (213) 316-6256.

  4. Proven DFM experience covering at least two to three manufacturing processes (e.g., injection molding, sheet metal, CNC, casting).

  6. Ability to manage assembly-level designs and complex mechanical systems, not just single-part modeling.

raw.description:
hatch I.T. is partnering with VanishID to find a Product Marketing Manager. Please see details below:

About the Role

VanishID is hiring a Product Marketing Manager to own their exposure management story. Security budgets still point at infrastructure while attackers target people, and the market is only starting to wake up to that gap. Your job is to make VanishID the company buyers and analysts think of when they do. This is a roll-up-your-sleeves role that blends product marketing, content, and campaign strategy, because on a lean team the story is not told with one skill. You will write the research the press quotes, build the pages and programs that teach CISOs a problem they have been told they cannot fix, arm their sales team and partners to win, and orchestrate campaigns that turn attention into pipeline.

It's an amazing time to join VanishID as one of their early employees. You will witness the impact of your work every day at this stage and reap the financial benefits. You will join a small, senior marketing team reporting to the VP of Marketing, where a peer product marketer owns their executive protection and workforce protection lines, along with brand and web. If you thrive in an energetic, focused environment and want to be surrounded by the momentum of equally driven teammates, VanishID will be a great place for you.

We are a remote-first company and are open to candidates throughout the United States. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

About the Company

VanishID is redefining digital executive protection. Their agentic AI platform continuously finds and removes executives' exposed personal information from data broker sites, neutralizes compromised credentials, and feeds security teams human-risk intelligence that strengthens the entire security program. Customers include Fortune 50 enterprises, major banks, healthcare systems, critical infrastructure operators, and family offices — in a category that is winning real security budget right now.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the story. Positioning and messaging for exposure management across the organization.
  • Translate the technical. Turn platform capabilities, research findings, vulnerability disclosures, and attack techniques into clear buyer-facing narratives.
  • Teach the market. The definition content, buyer's guide, webinars, and web pages that educate CISOs on a problem they have been told they cannot fix.
  • Lead our flagship research. Partner with product on the findings, perform surveys, write the report, and turn it into something the press repeats.
  • Run campaigns that land. Integrated campaigns and major launch moments, coordinating content, PR support, and analyst briefing preparation with the CEO and VP of Marketing.
  • Arm the field. Pitch decks, battlecards, demo narratives, objection handling, and rep training for our sales team and channel partners.
  • Fuel our alliances. Joint value propositions, integration briefs, and co-marketed campaigns and webinars with our technology and alliance partners.
  • Build the proof. Case studies and references with customer success that give our story its evidence.
  • Drive demand. Account-based plays for top target accounts, nurture flows, and clean lead handoff to sales.
  • Be the voice of the market. Win and loss insights, competitive intelligence, and customer research that shape product and sales.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in B2B SaaS marketing with 4+ years in product marketing. Cybersecurity required, and you have run launches in a high velocity environment.
  • Real security fluency. You have marketed to CISOs and security operations teams and can explain complex technical concepts to buyers. Experience with CTEM, EASM, attack surface management, identity security, or threat intelligence a huge plus.
  • Exceptional writing. Written samples of external-facing content for security buyers. We will ask, and you will be glad we did.
  • Campaign chops. Your campaigns turned into pipeline, and you can prove it. Here you create the content and call the plays. Specialists run them.
  • Self-starter mentality. You thrive as a generalist on a lean, remote team where ownership is the expectation, and you ship fast.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience producing original research or industry reports.
  • Experience with identity protection, threat intelligence, or OSINT.
  • Enjoys public speaking to technical security audiences on webinars and conferences.

raw.title: Golang Engineering Manager, Commercial Systems
raw.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets.
raw.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Golang Engineering Manager, who strives for accountability for the development of an internal product, who has high engineering quality standards, continuously develops their skills as well as skills of their direct reports, and who has the drive to deliver. This is an exciting opportunity to work with great people and exciting open-source solutions on innovative engineering solutions supporting Canonical's growth.

The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as six engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business and Golang plays an integral role in it. We are looking for software engineering managers for these teams:

The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business, payment systems. This team is an excellent match for those interested in growing their skills in the billing and payment processing domain.

The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for those interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Accountability for the design and development of an internal product
  • Leading a team of software engineers working in Golang
  • Developing the skills and capabilities of direct reports
  • Seeking improvements to established processes, designs, and solutions
  • Building an understanding of business neds to deliver the most impact

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Experience with software development in a high-level language (Golang, Python, Java, ...)
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Performance engineering and SRE experience
  • Experience with accounting, sales, sales operations, or other business roles

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Title: Strategic Project Lead, Coding/SWE

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

The Role

As a Strategic Projects Lead (SPL), you will own the end-to-end delivery of coding data pipelines used to train frontier AI models. You’ll work closely with AI Lab clients, software engineering experts, reviewers, and internal teams to ensure high-quality, scalable execution.

What You’ll Do

  1. Own end-to-end delivery of coding data pipelines, ensuring quality, timelines, and client alignment.
  2. Drive automation of pipeline workflows, including task generation, validation, QC, and reporting.
  3. Coordinate across experts, reviewers, MTS, and clients to maintain execution consistency and quality.
  4. Define task specifications, golden samples, and review rubrics to establish clear quality standards.
  5. Track and optimize pipeline health across quality, AHT, throughput, and delivery metrics.
  6. Lead continuous improvement based on client feedback, audits, and performance data.

What We’re Looking For

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  2. Strong understanding of software engineering and coding fundamentals.
  3. 2+ years leading technical projects, operations, or complex data workflows.
  4. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using metrics to drive improvements.
  5. Ability to translate client requirements into clear technical specifications and scalable workflows.
  6. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and client-facing teams.
  7. Startup mindset with a bias toward ownership, automation, and execution.

raw.description:
**This position is contingent upon contract award**

SOSi is seeking a Licensing & Contract Administrator to support mission requirements for a structured approach to further develop, integrate, and sustain a scalable, federated data ecosystem that enhances interoperability, governance, and mission-driven analytics for a DoD customer. The primary objective of the program is to bridge the operational gaps between DoD, IC, interagency, and non-traditional international partners to enable real-time information sharing, dynamic data integration, and mission-tailored analytical capabilities.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Manage enterprise software licenses and technology licensing agreements.
  • Ensure the optimization of service license utilization, coordinating with procurement management to prevent redundancy and cost overruns.
  • Submit the Software Licensing & Compliance Report, detailing license usage, renewal timelines, and compliance with procurement regulations.
  • Maintain a centralized license utilization register to ensure alignment with procurement ceilings, prevent duplicative purchases, and support budget transparency across the IDIQ portfolio.
  • Collaborate with legal, procurement, and technical teams to ensure contract and licensing compliance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Contract Law, Business Management, or a related field OR four (4) years of equivalent experience in contract administration.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) processes for software and technology licensing.
  • Experience ensuring compliance with DoD acquisition regulations and intellectual property policies.
  • Experience managing enterprise software licenses and tracking renewal cycles.
  • Experience ensuring vendor compliance with federal procurement requirements.
  • Experience with DoD licensing agreements and Software as a Service (SaaS) procurement.
  • Experience supporting enterprise contract negotiation activities.
  • Proficiency in license tracking and contract interpretation.
  • Experience with cost optimization strategies for software and hardware procurements.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM) certification.
  • IT Asset Management (ITAM) Certification.

Working Conditions:

  • The work to be performed remotely
  • Must have strong internet connection
  • Quit workspace free from interruptions and background noise

Working at SOSi:

All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason.

Founded in 1989, SOSi is among the largest private, founder-owned technology and services integrators in the defense and government services industry. We deliver tailored solutions, tested leadership, and trusted results to enable national security missions worldwide.

raw.excerpt: About usHighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
raw.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on ourYouTube Channel orBlog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

Equal Employment Opportunity Information

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

At Vertu Agent, we are a high-performance, client-focused firm operating across several industries. We combine innovation, professionalism, and collaboration to deliver exceptional service. Our Culture:

We prioritize excellence, accountability, and continuous learning. Our environment is collaborative yet results-driven, celebrating initiative, problem-solving, and high-impact contributions. Top performers are recognized, mentored, and given opportunities to take on leadership responsibilities.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Finance Operations Lead to support a U.S.-based financial services team. This role is ideal for someone with a strong operations background who also understands financial services and is comfortable taking ownership of processes, coordinating a team, and reporting directly to leadership.

The right person will learn the company's existing processes, help ensure they are followed consistently, and support the training and day-to-day coordination of advisors.

Key Responsibilities:

raw.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is hiring exceptional Revenue Operations analysts who will support a team of experts growing and managing our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. The Revenue Operations teams drive continuous policy, process and data quality improvement which enable us to analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.

You will support the leadership of the team, providing insights to drive improvements and partnering with Canonical’s teams across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal. This position requires an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the desire to strive for excellence. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about collaborating with sales and business development teams, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and contributing to initiatives in support of Canonical's continued success. Successful candidates will demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.

Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions

The role entails

  • Supporting all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales and business development functions globally
  • Driving data quality, through checking opportunities for accuracy, clean order processing, new hire training, policy and process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
  • Supporting and enabling the sales team globally on CRM and other revenue operations policies, processes and systems such as Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement, Data Enrichment, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions
  • Supporting other Revenue Operations Analysts and leadership team to report on and improve data quality, sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks.
  • Supporting planning, monitoring and improving revenue operations, across new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals. Delivering insight that enables improved territory and quota management, channel development and sales productivity.
  • Assisting the team with automation and streamlining of the end-to-end Lead to Order process

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Experience working as an analyst in revenue/sales operations or related fields such as financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent attention to detail and data-driven, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Planning and organisational skills, including the ability to interact and work with stakeholders across functions and at all levels of the organisation
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills, including comfort working with teams under commercial pressure
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business
  • Understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including within a team based remotely in multiple time zones

What Canonical offers

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Instrumentl is a profitable, hypergrowth, YC-backed SaaS platform building the operating system for grant-funded organizations. More than 5,500 nonprofits use Instrumentl to discover, track, and win grant funding, from local community organizations to the San Diego Zoo and the University of Alaska. Collectively they’ve moved over $1 billion through our platform.

We're growing quickly, customers love us (check out our G2 reviews!), and we're hiring people who want to build something that matters.

About the role:

    We're hiring an Outbound Sales Development Representative, reporting to the Senior Sales Development Manager, to build and own Instrumentl's cold outbound motion from the ground up. You'll be on the front lines identifying and reaching out to nonprofits and universities that could benefit from Instrumentl but don't know us yet, a function we've proven works and are now scaling. If you want to do meaningful sales work and build a career at the same time, this is the role.

  • Track account and decision-maker details in our CRM to set the sales team up to close

  • You don’t mind rolling up your sleeves and doing hard work
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills

Final compensation is determined based on experience, skillset, scope of responsibility, interview performance, and geographic location. We’re committed to paying competitively and equitably.

Once the 4-5 week training period is complete, team members will be expected to transition to a new schedule.

This role isn't for the typical rank and file customer service agent, so who is it for?

Our ideal candidate has years of experience spinning wrenches on V-twin motorcycles. Experience in mom and pop shops, dealerships, or even your own business is required so you can be a crucial technical resource not only for our customers, but also our department as a whole. To put it short: your standard wrenches are well worn and you bleed 20w50 oil!

Spinning the wrenches isn’t enough though, you love helping other riders get the parts and gear they need to stay on the road. When a friend gets a new bike you’re the first person they call to help them decide what they need to kit it out. Most importantly, you are an excellent communicator, both verbally and written.

Our Harley Techs are V-Twin aficionados that are devotees of the powersports industry and understand the importance of assuring a great customer experience, driving sales, and providing support for all riders that contact us with technical inquiries related to their motorcycles.

Our next Tech Team Member will:

  • Handle all levels of interaction with customers via phone, email, live chat, and other communication channels to take it one step forward toward facilitating all aspects of customer interaction with polish.
  • Assist with questions pertaining to fitment, application, selection, and installation of motorcycle parts and accessories.
  • Advise on proper fitment and use of safety gear including helmets, jackets, pants, riding armor, boot, gloves, and more.
  • Help customers place orders for a complete customer experience.
  • Continually learn about a combination of some of the following: motorcycle parts and gear, motorcycle riding, motorcycle racing, dirt bike and offroad riding, adventure/touring riding, supercross/MX, bike modification, among others.
  • Work with a wide variation of teams on a case by case basis to ensure that we overdeliver in every opportunity is what this position is all about!
  • Be detail-oriented, proactive, and conscientious with a commitment to self-improvement.
  • Be an excellent, polished communicator via verbal communication, as well as written.
  • Have the drive to assist their fellow riders all day, every day.

Our next Tech Team Member needs to have:

  • Commitment to Comoto’s Core Values
  • Passion for motorcycles and related products is a must
  • Familiar knowledge of motorcycle parts and accessories, Vtwin segment in particular
    • Working knowledge of additional power sports equipment including UTV, ATV, Scooters and Snowmobiles is a bonus
  • Sound problem solving and analytical skills
  • Established communication, interpersonal, and listening skills
  • Ability to interact and work in a fast-paced, team-driven environment
  • Time management skills and the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to work a schedule outside of standard business hours, including nights and weekends
  • Experience in retail, service, or hospitality industries is a plus
  • Ability to speak multiple languages is a plus
  • High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s degree or Tech school certification is a plus.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Comoto Holdings is America’s largest omnichannel platform in the powersports aftermarket-products industry; dedicated to advancing the experience of moto enthusiasts across the globe. Comoto’s brands, RevZilla, Common Tread, Cycle Gear, REVER, and J&P Cycles deliver premium products, dedicated expertise, engaging media, and passionate customer support of the rider community, through best-in-class e-commerce and retail experiences.

Accenture Edge for AWS is seeking a Technology Leader to serve as the core technical leader for the AWS business unit supporting mid-market AWS transformation. This leader owns the technology vision, technical direction, technical delivery leadership model, solution standards, delivery architecture, reusable assets, talent model, and technical governance required to help companies up to $3B in annual revenue adopt, migrate, modernize, optimize, and operate on AWS with enterprise-grade quality and mid-market speed. The Technology Leader will also serve as the field CTO-style leader and top technical point of contact for priority customers, large accounts, and strategic deals.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on AWS architecture credibility, technical delivery leadership, field CTO-style customer engagement, presales solutioning, and the ability to partner closely with sales, AWS field teams, delivery pods, managed services, and client executives. This role is accountable for being the primary technical authority for the AWS business unit, leading the technology charterin large accounts and complex deals, aligning solution strategy with customer business outcomes, and making Accenture Edge for AWS technically differentiated, repeatable, scalable, secure, cost-effective, and delivery-ready across packaged offerings and strategic pursuits.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the core technical leader for the AWS business unit: Own the technology vision, technical strategy, architecture principles, delivery standards, reusable accelerators, technical playbooks, and governance model for Accenture Edge for AWS.

  • Lead technical solutioning: Own solution quality across cloud migration, VMware migration, secure cloud foundation, managed services, FinOps, data modernization, AI modernization, Amazon Connect, DevOps, security, and modernization pursuits.

  • Serve as field CTO for customers: Act as the senior-most technical point of contact for priority customers, leading architecture strategy, technical vision, executive-level technology conversations, and trusted-advisor engagement with customer CIO, CTO, CISO, engineering, operations, and business leaders.

  • Lead the technology charter in large accounts and deals: Own technical strategy, solution architecture, delivery feasibility, risk posture, executive technical alignment, and architecture-to-delivery continuity for large accounts, complex pursuits, and strategic AWS transformation programs.

  • Partner with sales and AWS: Support customer discovery, executive workshops, AWS co-sell motions, ACE opportunities, proposal development, solution estimates, deal shaping, and technical differentiation for strategic pursuits.

  • Scale delivery readiness: Ensure offerings move from sale to delivery with clear scope, architecture, staffing model, pricing assumptions, acceptance criteria, delivery risks, and client success measures.

  • Develop technical talent: Build capability frameworks, certification paths, communities of practice, architecture review routines, and mentoring models for architects, engineers, consultants, and delivery leads.

  • Govern quality and risk: Establish technical review boards, Well-Architected discipline, security-by-design practices, delivery assurance checkpoints, and escalation paths for complex AWS engagements.

  • Improve repeatability: Convert successful delivery patterns into packaged offerings, accelerators, templates, automation, migration factories, runbooks, and managed services transition models.

  • Drive technology performance: Track technical quality, delivery productivity, certification progress, solution reuse, margin support, customer satisfaction, and offering adoption across the AWS business unit.

Success Measures

  • Delivery of at least 5–7 repeatable AWS offerings, reference architectures, or accelerators adopted by sales and delivery teams within the first 12 months.

  • Support for $50M–$100M in annual AWS services bookings, delivery portfolio, or managed services revenue.

  • Growth of AWS-certified technical talent by at least 25% year over year or creation of at least 25 new AWS certifications annually.

  • Achievement of 95% or higher SLA attainment, 4.5/5 or higher customer satisfaction, and reduced critical delivery escalations across active engagements.

  • Recognized technical leadership role in at least 5 priority customer accounts or strategic deals, including ownership of executive technical alignment, architecture direction, delivery readiness, and technical risk resolution.

  • Improvement in solution reuse, delivery productivity, cost estimation accuracy, and transition quality from sales to delivery.

  • Strengthened collaboration between technology, sales, AWS alliance, delivery, managed services, and client success teams.

Travel may be required for role. 0-100% depending on client and business needs

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, technology consulting, platform engineering, managed services, systems integration, or digital transformation delivery.

  • Minimum of 8+ years of hands-on AWS architecture, engineering, migration, modernization, operations, or cloud delivery experience.

  • Minimum of 8+ years leading technology vision, architecture strategy, delivery teams, cloud centers of excellence, or platform engineering teams for a cloud services or transformation business.

  • Minimum of 8+ years leading teams of at least 25–50 architects, engineers, consultants, delivery leads, or managed services professionals.

  • Minimum of 8+ years solutioning, governing, and delivering AWS cloud migration, modernization, managed services, data, AI, security, DevOps, or contact center engagements.

  • Minimum of 8+ years experience serving as senior technical sponsor, field CTO, chief architect, or top technical point of contact for at least 5 large customer accounts, strategic pursuits, or enterprise transformation programs.

  • Minimum of 8+ years experience leading technical delivery governance for at least 10 large-scale cloud programs with responsibility for architecture quality, delivery readiness, risk mitigation, technical escalation management, and customer executive alignment.

  • Minimum of 8+ years experience supporting at least $50M–$100M in annual cloud services bookings, delivery portfolio, managed services revenue, or AWS business unit technology-enabled revenue.

  • Experience creating certification, skills, or capability plans that increased AWS-certified talent by at least 25% year over year or produced at least 25 new AWS certifications annually.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate's degree, must have minimum 6 years' work experience).

Preferred Experience:

  • Deep knowledge of AWS core services, AWS Well-Architected Framework, landing zones, multi-account strategy, networking, security, DevOps, containers, serverless, data platforms, AI services, observability, and FinOps.

  • Ability to translate business outcomes into pragmatic, secure, scalable, and cost-effective AWS architectures for mid-market customers.

  • Strong executive communication skills and comfort leading technical discussions with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, engineering leaders, operations leaders, and business stakeholders.

  • Field CTO-style presence with the ability to operate as a trusted senior technical advisor, connect technology decisions to business outcomes, and guide customers through architecture tradeoffs, modernization complexity, and transformation risk.

  • Experience defining technology vision for a newly formed business unit, emerging service line, incubation business, cloud center of excellence, or startup-like technology organization within a larger company.

  • Familiarity with AWS partner programs, ACE, AWS Marketplace, AWS funding mechanisms, competency development, and joint technical validation motions.

  • Experience with packaged, fixed-scope, outcome-based, migration factory, modernization factory, or managed services delivery models.

  • Ability to balance hands-on technical credibility with business-unit technology vision, commercial awareness, delivery governance, and talent development.

  • Experience creating certification, skills, or capability plans that increased AWS-certified talent by at least 25% year over year or produced at least 25 new AWS certifications annually.Experience collaborating with at least 5 cross-functional groups such as sales, AWS alliance, solution architecture, delivery, security, finance, legal, managed services, product, or client success teams.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, or equivalent certifications are a plus.

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.
  • Contract:
    • Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
    • UK: Full-time, permanent
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

  • Life at Airalo · España:
  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom:

Ready to make travel easier for millions? Airalo is the world’s first and largest eSIM store, helping travellers stay connected seamlessly in over 200 countries and regions. We value empathy, ownership, and innovation, and trust our team to take initiative, put the customer first, and grow together while making a real impact every day.

Airalo’s fully remote Growth team is growing, and this is your chance to join a team where creativity runs wild. We empower our marketing geniuses to bring bold, innovative ideas to life. You’ll get to showcase the Airalo brand, excite travelers around the world, and experiment with the best marketing tech in the business, all while having the freedom to explore, create, and grow.

As Customer Retention Director at Airalo, you will own how we drive repeat usage, engagement, and long-term customer value. This role is about building a lifecycle system that drives real behavior, not just running campaigns.You will define how we activate users, bring them back, and increase frequency over time, owning retention as a system across CRM, Product, and Data, ensuring lifecycle is a core driver of revenue

You will be expected to answer:
“What actually makes users come back?”

Responsibilities include but are not limited to

  • Own retention as a cross functional system spanning CRM, Product, and Data

  • Define lifecycle strategy across activation, retention, engagement, and referral

  • Lead CRM channels end to end (push, email, in-app messaging, app inbox)

  • Define and drive Product requirements across onboarding, engagement, and lifecycle UX

  • Build and scale a lifecycle system that drives repeat usage and revenue

  • Work with Data and CRM to refine segmentation strategy across user types, markets, and behaviors

  • Design and run experiments across messaging, timing, journeys, and incentives

  • Partner with Data to define measurement frameworks, segmentation, and incrementality

  • Own how incentives (discounts, Airmoney, referrals) are used within lifecycle

  • Establish clear communication rules to avoid fatigue and overlap

  • Identify and prioritize the highest impact lifecycle opportunities

  • Translate insights into actionable changes across CRM and Product

Must Haves

  • 10+ years in CRM, lifecycle, retention, or growth roles

  • Experience owning lifecycle strategy in a B2C or mobile-first company

  • Strong hands-on experience with CRM platforms (CleverTap, Braze, Iterable, etc.)

  • Proven ability to drive measurable improvements in retention, LTV, or repeat rate

raw.description:
Launch your product career at Europe's leading music education platform

Matchspace Music is Europe's leading music education platform. We help thousands of music teachers build sustainable careers from teaching, and we are scaling fast across international markets. You will work directly with our VP Product.

This is a role for someone hungry. You want to see how a product is discovered, specified, built, shipped, measured and improved, and you want to be hands-on across the whole cycle. Everything we build follows one cycle: build, measure, learn, repeat. We are looking for a sharp analytical mind that is also creative in solving problems and providing fresh insights. In return you get a front-row seat in building AI-powered platforms, an AI-first way of working, and high visibility to the leadership team as we grow internationally.

Tasks

  • Feature conceptualization. Turn evidence into product ideas. You will run the full loop, from insight, to concept and options, to a sprint-ready story, and back to the data to see whether it worked.
  • Requirements engineering. Turn customer insights and support feedback into clear, buildable user stories with business context, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Own the qualification funnel so nothing rots and no ticket enters a sprint under-specified.
  • Sprint operations. Run backlog hygiene, standup and review mechanics, dependency flags and blocker tracking with our development team, so decisions get made once and stay made.
  • UAT, QA and testing. Own regression and release testing. Reproduce defects properly, keep the bug board honest, and support UAT and end-to-end dry runs.
  • Analytics and performance measurement. Own recurring KPI reporting across our tool stack, close measurement gaps, and turn funnel and cohort data into insight the team acts on. Every feature we ship is measured against the question: did it work? What was the impact?

Requirements

  • A relevant degree in business engineering, IT, information systems, digital business administration, or a related field, whether ongoing or recently completed.
  • Analytical and creative. You enjoy digging into data to find the real problem, and you are creative about how to solve it. Build-measure-learn is how you already think.
  • Structured and detail oriented. You find clean documentation and reproducible analysis satisfying, not tedious.
  • Comfortable with data. Excel/Sheets at a solid level, able to read dashboards, willing to learn fast
  • Proficient in German (min. B2) and English (C1). You can write a requirement someone else can build from. Your main operating language is English. German is essential for our Swiss home market.
  • Already using AI tools in your daily productivity workflow and genuinely curious about how software gets built.
  • Self-managing in a fast-moving, distributed team.

Nice to have

Agile/Scrum exposure, ticket systems, manual QA or test-case experience, and an interest in music, education or marketplaces.

Benefits

  • Work directly with the VP Product in a dynamic, cross-functional team spanning Product, Marketing and Customer Success.
  • Full end-to-end exposure: discovery, requirements, delivery, release, measurement and growth.
  • A front-row seat at Europe's leading music education platform, with real breadth across very different product challenges.
  • A modern, AI-first working culture.
  • A high-visibility talent role with direct exposure to the leadership team and an attractive international career trajectory as we scale.

We run a short, structured screening built around real examples of your work and how you think. Tell us who you are, why this role, and when you can start. We will take it from there.

  • Start: 15 September 2026

How you approach the work matters just as much as what you do. At Summit, our core values show up in how we make decisions, work together, and support our customers.

This role is built for performance-driven sellers who want their results to translate into meaningful earnings over time. Compensation is structured with uncapped commissions tied to recurring revenue, allowing you to build long-term value as you land and grow enterprise accounts.

With clear quota expectations and accelerator opportunities for exceeding targets, strong performance is consistently rewarded. As deals increase in size and complexity, so does the opportunity to grow your earnings.

Your Benefits & Perks...
